name: XHS Product Search
description: 采集小红书商品与店铺数据为结构化 JSON（售价、到手价、发货地、评分、上架日期、SKU 数、已售、店铺名、粉丝数等）；可保存为 Markdown 笔记（同一商品再次采集会自动更新原笔记），也可作为其他插件的数据后端。免登录、免 Python，桌面版与手机版均可用。｜ Collect Xiaohongshu product & shop data into structured JSON — save as Markdown notes (re-collecting a product updates the same note), or use it as a data backend for other plugins. No login, no Python; desktop and mobile.
author: GitBinS
